policy:91c9cf21-825c-4ba2-b741-f19fe5a85: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
policy:56560b23-8032-4ed3-aed6-3cb12d002: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
policy:4b21bc19-bd37-44bd-9501-7feb23ccd: All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
answer:c116a7ba-6031-4328-9757-b49e15ef8: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
answer:f416ffd1-1945-45cf-9afb-9770e2996: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
